Name: Seasonal Grass Paths for Foliage Redone
Author: DuckVendetta
Description:
My personal blend of the Grass Path idea by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51184691]mdscatharina[/url] (not required) to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url]﻿'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4705]Foliage Redone Recolour[/url]﻿ and their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4852]Seasonal Path and Flooring[/url]﻿.

Consider using my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7705]Gravel Sound Replacer[/url]﻿ for further immersion -replaces the gravel sounds with grass sound.

Now with clean version as a config option.
